selection: User-nominated projects; two known Zweig catalogue records and the Schuchardt letter linked from the correspondence landing page. Cases were inspected before implementation; no holdout or independent selection is claimed.
authority: Bounded source observations and project-authored model choices; no human verification or complete edition migration.

sources.title: Stefan Zweig Digital: Werke
sources.creator: Literaturarchiv Salzburg; Zentrum für Informationsmodellierung, Universität Graz

required_observations: Two distinct catalogue records and shelfmarks retain their common work reference without inferring equal text, versions, or physical objects.
The uncertain hand attribution retains its question mark and does not assign an ordinal certainty on import.
The independently encoded contributor role does not remove the hand attribution's uncertainty.
The dateline, origin date, and sent-action date retain separate locators and scopes; no postal event is inferred.
Import responsibility does not impersonate the unidentified author of an individual source attribution.
Exact quotation and source integrity are checked independently of semantic support and scholarly truth.
Synthetic revision and transcription examples remain explicitly distinct from the acquired edition records.
limits: No images, external registers, complete ODD, or full correspondence corpus acquired.
The paired catalogue records do not establish a textual version relationship.
No manuscript hand comparison or actual mailing date established.
Both sources retain CC BY-NC 4.0 as declared in their XML headers; project licences do not replace source licences.
